map.→ 打开水锤防护计算工具: -> Open the water hammer protection calculator tool
map.停泵工况按波速与流速变估算水锤升压。: Water hammer pressure rise for the pump-stopping condition, estimated from wave speed and flow velocity.
map.填写「水锤波速 a (m/s)」。: Enter the "water hammer wave speed a (m/s)".
map.根据管路关阀时间与水锤波传播相长，判定直接水锤或间接水锤，计算关阀引起的升压值并: Based on the valve closure time and the phase relationship of the water hammer wave propagation, it decides between direct and indirect water hammer, computes the pressure rise caused by closure and evaluates the safety of the pipe section, then recommends protection such as slow-closing valves, surge tanks or air valves to reduce the risk of pipe burst.
map.水锤防护计算 使用指南: How to use the water hammer protection calculator
map.波速 a 怎么估？: How is the wave speed a estimated?
map.液压缸推力速度行程计算: Hydraulic cylinder thrust, speed and stroke calculation
map.由管材弹性与水体压缩性定，钢管约 1000~1200 m/s，塑料管更低。: It is set by the pipe material elasticity and the compressibility of water: about 1000-1200 m/s for steel pipe and lower for plastic pipe.
map.缓闭止回阀、水锤罐、减压旁路组合，依管道长度与工况选。: A combination of slow-closing check valve, surge tank and pressure relief bypass, chosen according to the pipe length and the operating conditions.
map.选型水锤消除器或缓闭阀。: Choose a water hammer eliminator or a slow-closing valve.
map.长管道校核峰值压力是否超管承压。: For a long pipe, check whether the peak pressure exceeds the pipe pressure rating.
map.：ρ=1000、a=1000 m/s、Δv=2 → Δp=1000×1000×2: : ρ=1000, a=1000 m/s, Δv=2 -> Δp=1000*1000*2=2.0 MPa, which exceeds the rating of many fittings and needs protection.
map.：将 Δv 在 5 s 内降到 0.2，瞬变升压大幅下降，避免爆管。: : reducing Δv to 0.2 within 5 s lowers the transient pressure rise sharply and avoids pipe burst.
